source: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, roll 2d8 and 1d6. The target takes damage equal to the total, of a type set by the lower of the two d8s: 1 acid, 2 cold, 3 fire, 4 force, 5 lightning, 6 poison, 7 psychic, 8 thunder. If the two d8s match, the energy leaps to a different creature within 30 feet of the target and you make a new attack roll against it, continuing as long as the dice keep matching and there are new targets.
Chromatic Orb

You throw a 4-inch sphere of raw energy at a creature you can see within range. Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder as the orb forms, then make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit the target takes 3d8 damage of the type you picked.
Compelled Duel

You challenge a creature you can see within range to fight you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be drawn to you: while the spell lasts it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw to move more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you attack anyone else, cast a harmful spell on anyone else, or end your turn more than 30 feet from the target.
Earth Tremor

The ground bucks in a 10-foot radius around you. Every other creature there makes a Dexterity saving throw, falling prone and taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure. Any loose earth caught in the radius becomes difficult terrain.
Gift of Alacrity
A willing creature you touch reacts faster than it should. While the spell lasts it rolls an extra 1d8 and adds it to every initiative roll it makes.
Hail of Thorns

The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack while this spell is active, thorns explode from the target. It and every creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure and half as much on a success.
Hex

You lay a curse on a creature you can see within range. Until the spell ends, your attacks that hit the cursed creature deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. Name one ability when you cast the spell: the cursed creature has disadvantage on ability checks made with it. Should the creature drop to 0 hit points before the spell ends, you may spend a bonus action on a later turn of yours to move the curse to another creature. A remove curse spell cast on the creature ends the spell early.
Magnify Gravity

Gravity doubles in a 10-foot-radius sphere within range. Each creature there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 force damage on a failure and having its speed halved until the end of your next turn, or half damage on a success.
Puppet
You force a creature within range to move at your word. On a failed Wisdom saving throw it moves up to half its speed in a direction you choose, and can be made to drop what it is holding.
Silvery Barbs

A sudden stab of doubt unsettles the creature that just succeeded. It rerolls the d20 and must keep the lower of the two results. You then pass the stolen confidence to any creature you can see within range, which gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check or saving throw made within the next minute.
Snare

You weave a hidden trap into a 5-foot square of floor. The first Large or smaller creature to enter it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be magically hoisted into the air, restrained and hanging upside down, until it or another creature escapes with a successful Arcana check or the rope is cut.
Sudden Awakening
A wave of alertness rolls out from you. Each creature you choose within 30 feet immediately wakes, stands up from prone at no movement cost, and is freed from magical sleep.
Caustic Brew

A stream of acid sprays out in a 30-foot line, 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid, taking 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape the acid off itself or another creature, ending the effect on that creature.
Thunderous Smite

The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack while this spell is active, the attack deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.
Wild Cunning

You touch the ground and call on the wisdom of the wild. You learn one useful fact about the surrounding half mile of your choosing: where to find food and water, the safest path, tracks of a creature type, or the nearest shelter.
Witch Bolt

A beam of crackling energy lances toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d12 lightning damage and the beam remains connected. On each of your later turns you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically, and the spell ends if the target moves more than 30 feet away or gains total cover.
Wrathful Smite

The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack while this spell is active, the attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage. The target must then succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the spell ends. A frightened target can spend its action on a Wisdom check against your spell save DC to end the effect on itself.
Zephyr Strike

The air carries you. Until the spell ends your movement never provokes opportunity attacks, and once during that time you may claim advantage on a single weapon attack roll, adding 1d8 force damage on a hit and 30 feet of speed for the rest of that turn.
Scorcher
Roaring flame erupts from you along a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. Every creature caught in it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 fire damage on a failure and half as much on a success.
